Package com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.ott

Record Class OttProperties

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.irurueta.authserver.authorization.application.ott.OttProperties
Record Components:
codeLength - number of digits of a code (default 6).
codeTtl - how long a code is valid (default 10 minutes).
linkTtl - how long a magic link is valid (default 15 minutes).
maxAttempts - verification attempts a code allows before it is burnt (default 5).
@ConfigurationProperties("authserver.ott") public record OttProperties(int codeLength, Duration codeTtl, Duration linkTtl, int maxAttempts) extends Record
Settings of the one-time codes, bound from authserver.ott.* once and validated at startup. A missing (or zero, for a number) value takes its default, so the application starts without any setting.
